rules.notes: 0.025% on the sell side only. Statutory; never part of a GST base. Law: Finance (No. 2) Act, 2004 s.98 Table Sl. 3 (sale settled otherwise than by delivery): 0.025 per cent. Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 2.

SEBI turnover fee, Rs 10 per crore of traded value. Law: SEBI (Stock Brokers) Regulations, 2026 fee schedule; before 7-1-2026 the 1992 Regulations, Schedule V Part B cl. 3(1) (from 1-4-2019): 0.00010 per cent of turnover, Rs 10 per crore. Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 7.

0.003%, or Rs 300 per crore, on the buy side only. Statutory; never part of a GST base. Law: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Schedule I Article 56A(c), transfer on non-delivery basis: 0.003% (Finance Act 2019, in force 1-7-2020). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 5.

18% on the taxable services. The base is listed explicitly; securities transaction tax and stamp duty are absent by design (D1). Law: CGST 9% + SGST 9%, or IGST 18%: heading 9971, financial and related services not elsewhere listed (Notification 11/2017-Central Tax (Rate) Sl. 15; 8/2017-Integrated Tax (Rate)). Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-statutory-charge-rates.md row 8.
